evidence: traced 2026-11-18 through templates and routes: commissary.disyl:2054 openDispatchEntry -> dispatch-dr-number -> /api/v1/commissary/dispatch; ledger.disyl:366 openDispatchModal -> cashier/dispatch_modal.disyl:284 -> /api/v1/cashier/ledger/dispatch; deliveries.disyl:592 -> /api/v1/deliveries/create
reason: Owner 2026-11-18 asked 'Send to branch or the new delivery modal? which is which?' - a summary that named the branch-side control for a commissary user is exactly how the wrong page gets opened.
text: Three dispatch surfaces are easy to confuse, and naming the wrong one sends the operator to a page they are refused. (1) 'New Delivery (DR)' on the COMMISSARY sheet (/daily-ledger/admin/commissary, openDispatchEntry) posts to /api/v1/commissary/dispatch - commissary to branch, the lane production_in_charge uses, and the one that carries the DR. (2) 'Open Send to Branch' on the BRANCH ledger (/daily-ledger/ledger, openDispatchModal) posts to /api/v1/cashier/ledger/dispatch - branch to branch/consignee/commissary. (3) 'New Delivery' on the office Deliveries page posts to /api/v1/deliveries/create and is admin recovery only. Never tell a commissary user to use 'Send to Branch': their control is 'New Delivery (DR)'.
